name: MonarchBarList
title: BarList
summary: A ranked list with a bar behind each row's label: top pages, top referrers, rivals by score.
whenToUse: To compare a handful of values by size where the labels matter more than exact axes: top pages, top referrers, conversion by channel.
whenNotToUse: For a value against a limit use MonarchProgress or MonarchUsageMeter. For a trend over time use MonarchSparkline. For a long, scrolling list of records use a LazyColumn of list items.
api: @Composable fun MonarchBarList(items: List<MonarchBarListItem>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, sort: MonarchBarListSort = MonarchBarListSort.Descending, maximum: Double? = null, limit: Int? = null, ranked: Boolean = false, loading: Boolean = false, label: String? = null, formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, onSelect: ((MonarchBarListItem) -> Unit)? = null, missingLabel: String? = null, emptyLabel: String? = null, loadingLabel: String? = null, overflowLabel: String? = null)

class MonarchBarListItem(label: String, value: Double?, id: String = label, description: String? = null, displayValue: String? = null, highlighted: Boolean = false, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
enum class MonarchBarListSort { Descending, Ascending, None }

options.name: sort
options.description: Descending, Ascending or None. Rows without a value go last; equal values keep their order.

options.name: maximum
options.description: The value of a full bar. The largest value when null. Pass 1.0 for ratios of a whole.

options.name: limit
options.description: Shows only the first rows, with a "Top 5 of 12" footer.

options.name: ranked
options.description: Numbers the rows. The numbers are not read; the order carries the rank.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows a progress indicator and "Loading" instead of the rows.

options.name: label
options.description: Names the list for TalkBack, such as "Top pages".

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes a value. The default is a number in the current locale.

options.name: emptyLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in text "No data yet" (monarch_barlist_empty).

states.name: default
states.description: Rows sorted by value, each with a bar as long as its share of the largest value.

states.name: missing value
states.description: A dash instead of the value, read as "No value", and no bar.

states.name: selectable
states.description: With onSelect every row is at least 48dp high, shows the ripple and draws the focus ring.

states.name: loading
states.description: A circular progress indicator and the loading text.

appearance: Each row has an 8dp muted track under its label, filled in the first data color for its share; a highlighted row has a semibold label and value; descriptions, rank numbers, the footer and the dash use muted text. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web draws the bar on a track under the label or inline; here the bar is behind the label, the usual form on a narrow screen, as on iOS, so there is no layout option. The web formats numbers, percentages and currencies from options; here formatValue takes a function. Row links (href) become onSelect, because navigation in an app is not a URL. The web loading state draws skeleton rows; here it is a progress indicator. The parity map named a LazyColumn; the rows are a plain Column instead, because a bar list is short (use limit) and a LazyColumn cannot sit inside a scrolling screen.
accessibility: Each row is one TalkBack element: its label and description, then its value.
A row without a value reads "No value" in place of the dash.
Bars and rank numbers are not read; the order of the rows carries the rank.
The list exposes collection info (a list of n rows) and, with a label, the label as its content description.
With onSelect each row has the Button role, a click action and a touch target at least 48dp high, and draws the focus ring.
A highlighted row has a heavier label and value; the emphasis is not spoken, so say why in the label.
Labels wrap and are not cut off at font scale 2.0; row content starts at the start edge in both layout directions.
edgeCases: Equal values keep the order they were given in.
Values that are not finite are treated as missing.
Negative values and an all-zero list draw no bars.
A value above maximum draws a full bar.
limit hides rows but the scale still uses the largest value of all items.
Item ids default to the label.

examples.title: Top pages with links
examples.template:
MonarchBarList(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchBarListItem({{items.0.label}}, {{items.0.value|double}}, id = {{items.0.id}}),
        MonarchBarListItem({{items.1.label}}, {{items.1.value|double}}, id = {{items.1.id}}),
        MonarchBarListItem({{items.2.label}}, {{items.2.value|double}}, id = {{items.2.id}}),
        MonarchBarListItem({{items.3.label}}, {{items.3.value|double}}, id = {{items.3.id}}),
        MonarchBarListItem({{items.4.label}}, {{items.4.value|double}}, id = {{items.4.id}}),
    ),
    label = {{label}},
    formatValue = { "${NumberFormat.getIntegerInstance(Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}})).format(it)} {{unit|raw}}" },
    onSelect = {},
)
examples.code:
MonarchBarList(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchBarListItem("/", 4820.0, id = "home"),
        MonarchBarListItem("/pricing", 2310.0, id = "pricing"),
        MonarchBarListItem("/docs/getting-started", 1640.0, id = "docs"),
        MonarchBarListItem("/blog/release-notes", 920.0, id = "blog"),
        MonarchBarListItem("/contact", 310.0, id = "contact"),
    ),
    label = "Top pages",
    formatValue = { "${NumberFormat.getIntegerInstance(Locale.forLanguageTag("en-US")).format(it)} views" },
    onSelect = {},
)

examples.title: Ratios of a whole, selectable
examples.code:
MonarchBarList(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchBarListItem("Email", 0.12, displayValue = "12%"),
        MonarchBarListItem("Search", 0.31, displayValue = "31%"),
    ),
    maximum = 1.0,
    label = "Conversion by channel",
    onSelect = { selected = it.label },
)
